column1: # Captured 2026-08-13, 72 playlist items, in playlist order.
# The playlist contains 72 items and 71 distinct works: Debussy's Clair de Lune
# appears twice, at positions 9 and 69. Both rows are kept so this file stays a
# faithful capture. The build deduplicates by catalog_id when it emits
# playlists.json, keeping first-occurrence order (D-032 makes adds idempotent).
# This file lists WORKS, not Rousseau's recordings. Rousseau's arrangements and
# performances are his own copyrighted work and are never fetched, embedded or
# redistributed — only the underlying compositions, which are public domain, and
# only from sources whose own licences permit redistribution (PRD F2).
#   composer   canonical "Surname, Forename" as used in catalog/manifest.json
#   work       the work as Rousseau titles it, normalised
#   catalog_id manifest id when status is have/verify, otherwise empty
# Trailing empty columns may be absent — a row with no note ends after
# catalog_id. Parsers must pad to five fields, not index blindly.
#   have      resolved to a shipped catalog row; nothing to do
#   verify    a catalog row is very likely this work, but the row's title does
#             not name the opus. Confirm against the row's Mutopia page
#             (piece-info.cgi?id=<mutopiaId>) and then set to have or missing.
#   missing   public-domain work absent from the catalog; source it (T13)
#   excluded  cannot be shipped, or is not a single work. Never auto-source.
